name: a-stalled-notes-search-becomes-an-error
breaks: a web search that never comes back is shown as still running forever. A wait with no deadline cannot fail, it can only hang, and a hang is indistinguishable from slowness (#693, L110). The deadline moved here when the two byte-identical copies of it became one (#718), so breaking it now breaks every long run at once; this entry proves the notes search is one of them
